lado_card.texto: G0 shows the agentic company and the role of the 2027 manager. The other courses in the program build on it.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · eventos.inema.pro/gestao-ia · Horizonte lab (fictional study company) · inema.club

inicio.lead: Creating an agent got easy. Answering for what it does did not. In eight lessons you write an agent's digital role, delegation, constitution and authority limits. You decide when it earns more autonomy, when it becomes a team, and how to handle exceptions. You finish with the hiring dossier, approved by a rubric.
inicio.capa_alt: A sales manager at a distributor points to an approval queue dashboard while the team works; in the background, the cleaning products stock.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order a manager receives an agent: hire (role and delegation), guide (constitution), limit (authority), loosen your grip with evidence, build the team and supervise. Lesson 8 pulls it all together in the dossier.

itens: Area managers, owners of small and midsize businesses, and operations or HR leaders who already have AI agents on their team, or soon will.
People who don't code and don't want to: here you manage the agent. Building an agent is a different course.
People who have to answer for what the agent does: the discount it gave, the order it approved, the customer it served.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Write an agent's job sheet with a mission, a verifiable deliverable, prohibited actions and a human owner.
Delegate a task with a goal, context, tools, deadline and proof of completion.
Set authority limits action by action (green, yellow, red) and promote or demote with evidence.
Run the exception queue: approve, send back or stop, always with a reason.

blocos.t: The case that runs through the course
itens: Horizonte Distribuidora, a fictional study company of 40 people that distributes cleaning products in the interior of São Paulo.
You play Patrícia Lima, sales manager, who just received Hora, an agent that sells over WhatsApp. The process is the order that arrives on WhatsApp and runs through to invoicing.

The flaws planted in the lab (a discount with no cap, a hidden instruction, a large order with no approval) become management problems. Every lesson has one practice on Horizonte and another on your own process.
